name: Mina Coss
source_profile:
Mina Coss (N) — Independent Mine Proprietor

Mina is a hardworking and increasingly prosperous prospector who owns a small but productive silver claim in the foothills outside Blackvein. She arrived following the War of Broken Banners with little money and spent nearly everything she possessed purchasing equipment and securing a mineral concession from the newly established authorities.

Her circumstances became considerably more complicated when representatives of the Blackpick Claimholders produced an ancient dwarven deed covering part of the same workings. Mina maintains that she purchased her claim legally and has invested years of labor developing it. The Blackpicks argue that the royal concession was issued over mineral rights their ancestors never surrendered.

Mina has little personal quarrel with the dwarves and recognizes the sincerity of their claim. Nevertheless, she refuses to abandon a mine upon which her entire livelihood depends. Her dispute has become a frequent subject of discussion throughout Blackvein, with some residents regarding her as the victim of an impossible legal predicament and others accusing her of profiting from the dispossession of the dwarven diaspora.
